latest_release.name: Craft Anything v0.6.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Keep Mach-O zero-fill sections out of file-backed section data (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1348
* Read decimal digit separators when filling added SQLite columns (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1318
* Verify Cargo package versions before reporting Rust dependencies (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1329
* Read the Swift standard type SQ as Equatable (R3.12) by @Chr0mium24 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1350
* Let a Deep build through Claude Code start subagents again (R2.2, #1105) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1351
* Decode Swift protocols named in a protocol list (R3.12) by @Chr0mium24 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1353
* Read the kind letter of Swift addressors (R3.12) by @Chr0mium24 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1354
* Name the right generic parameter in Swift associated types (R3.12) by @Chr0mium24 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1355
* Name Swift allocating initialisers init outside classes (R3.12) by @Chr0mium24 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1356
* Keep parentheses around Swift optional function types (R3.12) by @Chr0mium24 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1357
* Decode Swift enum case symbols (R3.12) by @Chr0mium24 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1359
* docs: add SonarCloud and CodeRabbit badges to README by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1361
* Preserve GNU tar member identities at the long-name limit by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1362
* Keep ELF symbol versions inside their declared sections (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1368
* Reject PE virtual addresses that wrap past the address space (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1370
* Bound retained metadata when listing Node SEA programs (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1377
* Decode Unity R16 and RG16 textures (R3.9) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1378
* Keep same-named imports attached to their own library slots (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1365
* Advance ELF core mapping paths by their original bytes (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1366
* Recover dynamic symbols when retained ELF sections omit the symbol table (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1367
* Respect the UTF-8 output budget for IL2CPP literals (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1380
* Apply PE export limits to aliases and empty function slots (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1384
* Read Mach-O thread entry points from the matching complete CPU state (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1385
* Bound Mach-O indirect import slots across all sections (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1386
* Stop a private browser and delete its profile when the app ends without closing it (R2.9, #810) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1376
* Preserve DEX boundaries when member or handler lists are capped (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1388
* Keep Android resource children inside their parent chunks (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1389
* Bound WebAssembly metadata across repeated custom sections (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/1390
* Validate Unity serialized metadata ranges before reading (R3.12) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/p
